description: Collect the emails, phone numbers and social profiles a page visibly publishes. Emails, phone numbers and social profile links visibly published on a page, read from the rendered DOM and mailto: and tel: links. Nothing is inferred, enriched or cross-referenced: only what the page itself shows. Body: {url}. — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "get contact email from the site", "extract all email addresses from this website", "find the phone number on a company site".
name: web_contacts
